jobs.description:
Department: **Sustainability Data Solutions & AI

**Location: **Bagsværd, Denmark

****Your impact begins here

**As an intern in Sustainability Data Solutions & AI, you will turn sustainability data into insight Novo can act on. You will develop a data analytics use case that combines energy and water data from source systems with global sustainability data, and help make that data cleaner, more reliable and easier to reuse. Working on real business challenges alongside experienced data analysts and engineers, you will see your work support decisions across the organisation.

**What You’ll Bring

**You are curious, analytical and motivated by using data and technology to solve sustainability challenges. You are a student, and you bring:

A basic understanding of sustainability, environmental data or ESG topics, for example energy, water or greenhouse gas emissions.

Experience with Power BI or another data visualisation or BI tool.

Experience with at least one coding language, such as Python.

An interest in AI, automation and advanced analytics, and in how they can be applied to sustainability challenges.

A structured way of working with a clear eye for detail, and the ability to work independently while supporting those around you.

The ability to explain data clearly to colleagues with less technical insight, with strong written and spoken English.

Familiarity with data engineering, data pipelines or cloud-based analytics platforms, such as Databricks.

Knowledge of statistical modelling, operational research or operations management.

Experience with larger datasets, including data cleaning, transformation, validation or analysis.

**What You’ll Do

**You will contribute to real projects, taking ownership of selected tasks while supporting the wider team’s initiatives. Your work will help strengthen how sustainability data is collected, integrated, analysed and used across Novo.

Develop a data analytics use case that combines energy and water data from source systems with global sustainability data, turning operational data into actionable business insight.

Support the integration and automation of sustainability data in the Sustainability Data Foundation, including data pipelines and automated recurring reporting and data-quality controls in Databricks.

Improve the quality, transparency and availability of sustainability data by creating clean, reliable and reusable datasets in line with the FAIR principles: Findable, Accessible, Interoperable and Reusable.

Support the digitalisation of sustainability data and analytics by connecting sustainability information with relevant business and operational metrics.

Contribute to BI solutions for reporting, forecasting and decision-making, as well as ad hoc analyses across sustainability data and technology.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the Sustainability Data Solutions & AI team, part of the Sustainability Strategy and Insights department. The team of data analysts and data engineers drives data analytics on the sustainability agenda for Novo. The department has eight colleagues at headquarters, two in Poland and two in Bangalore, India, so you will work with colleagues across locations.

You will also work closely with stakeholders across Novo who are helping to implement the sustainability strategy across the value chain. Your manager will be [insert hiring manager name]. You will move work forward by bringing technical depth and clear communication together, from deep dives into the data to conversations with colleagues who are less familiar with it.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will work on real business challenges, with room to take ownership and make your voice heard. You will learn from experienced data and sustainability professionals, build practical skills in tools such as Databricks and Power BI, and see how data and AI are applied to sustainability across a global organisation. The pace is fast, and you will be supported to perform at your best.

If allowed by your educational institution, the internship is paid at a fixed monthly base rate of DKK 15,900, plus a pension scheme (currently 10% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution).

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn sustainability data into insight and progress, apply for the Internship in Sustainability Data Solutions & AI by November 20, 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We are now looking for our new People Operations Manager to join our Global Operations Team (GOT) - People Advisory Services

As a People Operations Manager, you will play a critical leadership role in delivering a caring, consistent and high-quality employee experience across the end-to-end Hire-to-Retire lifecycle. You will lead People Operations Advisors across multiple locations and be accountable for day-to-day service delivery, process excellence, team engagement and the smooth execution of key employee lifecycle activities. You will combine deep HR operations expertise with a strong focus on care, operational discipline and continuous improvement.

What We Offer

We offer you an exciting global career at the forefront of world trade. And thanks to our global scale, you will be well-positioned to explore opportunities at Maersk around the world. The many other highlights include the most modern talent development initiatives and competitive benefits. We are proud of our people who define our company’s industry leadership, global team culture and customer-centric focus every day.

• Coach and develop team members through clear goals, regular feedback and continuous learning in HR processes and systems.

• Plan resource allocation, workload distribution and case assignment to ensure effective service delivery and coverage.

• Oversee timely, accurate and high-quality HR operational services across the end-to-end employee lifecycle.

• Enhance recruitment operations by improving efficiency and supporting compliance across the brands served.

• Ensure accurate data entry in Workday and other HR systems, with a strong focus on data integrity and audit readiness.

• Resolve or escalate complex employee queries and provide guidance on policies, benefits and local compliance matters.

• Drive and monitor KPIs and service levels, provide visibility of key metrics, and take corrective action where required.

• Identify root causes of process inefficiencies and implement improvements that strengthen employee experience and case resolution.

• Promote adoption of employee self-service tools and ensure supporting content is clear, accurate and accessible.

• Lead and contribute to HR projects and standardization efforts across geographies.

• Act as a key liaison between GOT and other EEO workstreams, aligning shared initiatives and service delivery.

• Build strong stakeholder relationships through proactive communication, updates and cross-functional collaboration.

• Strengthen collaboration and alignment between Europe PA Managers and Hub PA Managers

• Support change communications and deliver training on new tools, processes, policies and HR systems.

We’re looking for

• 10+ years of experience in HR operations and generalist roles within large international organisations, including team leadership experience.

• Strong understanding of end-to-end HR service delivery; payroll and works council experience is an advantage.

• Proven leadership capability with experience managing diverse and distributed teams.

• Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across multiple organisational levels.

• Demonstrated ability to coach, motivate and develop team members.

• Strong customer focus and commitment to delivering high-quality employee experiences in high-volume environments.

• Continuous improvement mindset with experience leading or supporting change and process improvement initiatives.

• Strong interpersonal, relationship-building and conflict-resolution skills.

• Ability to manage shifting priorities and deliver outcomes within agreed timelines and scope.

• Analytical and process-oriented approach with a strong focus on efficiency, accuracy and system optimisation.

We're looking for a Customer Success Manager to lead complex enterprise implementations in a fast-moving company on a mission to help businesses fight financial crime and simplify compliance.

This role combines project leadership, technical problem-solving, and hands-on work with customer data. You'll get a front-row seat to how large organizations run KYC and compliance - and you'll be the one who makes it painless for them. Customer pain is our pain, and your goal is to turn their messy real-world problems into a smooth, structured onboarding experience.

You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable acting as an owner of the data workstream in onboarding and collaborating closely on integration-dependent deliveries.

You'll own implementations end-to-end for a portfolio of customers: project plans, stakeholder alignment, data mapping, validation, troubleshooting, and clear communication throughout delivery.

You'll work closely with peers in Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and Support, especially when delivery depends on integrations, APIs, or data workflows.

We're open to strong mid-level and senior candidates.

After go-live, you'll stay close enough to support adoption and a smooth handover into the broader customer lifecycle.

**Example projects you might run

**

• Enterprise onboarding: Managing multiple stakeholders (Compliance, IT, business owners) against a fixed go-live date.

• Data intake and migration: Mapping customer data into Avallone templates, validating outcomes, and troubleshooting edge cases.

• Integration-dependent delivery: Aligning requirements, timelines, and technical dependencies across teams.

• Most weeks you'll have multiple onboardings or delivery workstreams running in parallel, so executing with urgency, communicating clearly, and keeping momentum is key.

**Roles + Responsibilities

**

• Act as an owner for onboarding and implementation for your customer portfolio: build project plans, coordinate stakeholders, and drive execution against timelines.

• Lead the technical workstream: handle data intake, mapping, validation, troubleshooting, and iterative improvement of datasets.

• Turn customer processes into concrete steps: capture requirements, map processes, and build clear action plans.

• Run customer-facing communication: provide status updates, manage risk, and set expectations with everyone from compliance specialists to executives.

• Drive cross-functional success: work with Product and Engineering when delivery involves integrations/APIs; surface issues early, help drive them to closure, and feed insights back into the product roadmap.

• Support post-go-live motions: conduct adoption check-ins and health checks, and contribute to QBR preparation.

• Notice early when a customer is drifting, put a plan on the table, and drive it.

• Flag when a customer is ready for more (more users, workflows, or products) and bring the context to Sales.

• Share what you learn so the team gets faster over time (checklists, templates, SOPs, playbook improvements).

**What Success Looks Like (first 6 Months)

**

• You've delivered multiple onboardings to a predictable go-live without surprises in the final stretch.

• Customers trust the output: uploads are validated, issues are documented clearly, and fixes happen fast.

• You've helped customers reach meaningful early value (Activation) and built momentum towards steady, everyday use.

• You've improved at least one repeatable artifact (template/checklist/SOP) based on patterns you've seen in real implementations.

**Requirements

**We'll hire at the level that matches your experience.

**Core Requirements

**

• Experience in Customer Success, onboarding/implementation, project management, or a similar customer-facing role in a SaaS environment.

• Strong project management skills: you can create structure, align people, and keep delivery moving.

• Technical aptitude and comfort working hands-on with customer data (not just coordinating): CSVs/templates, mapping, validation checks, troubleshooting, and attention to detail.

• Professional proficiency in both written and verbal communication in English.

• Strong ownership and follow-through.

**What tends to make people successful in this role

**

• You like turning messy, real-world problems into a clear plan and getting it done.

• You communicate early when something is off track.

• You know when "good enough to ship" is the right call, and you document what you did.

**Leveling guidance

**

• Mid-level: you can run well-scoped onboardings, execute established workflows, and escalate early when needed.

• Senior: you lead the toughest implementations, handle ambiguity, coach others through tricky technical/data cases, and drive cross-functional execution.

**Bonus points

**

• Strong proficiency in Danish is a big plus.

• API-enabled implementations and/or data integrations.

• Experience in compliance-heavy domains (KYC/AML, sanctions, risk, or similar).

• Comfortable using simple tooling to validate/troubleshoot data (e.g., basic SQL, Excel/Sheets checks, BI).

**Why Avallone?

**At Avallone, implementations matter commercially, operationally, and for customer trust. You'll work on real delivery problems with smart colleagues across Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and Support.

You'll help shape how we run onboardings as we scale, and you'll join a company that values a true people-first culture. We care about our customers, our values, and each other.

We focus on your passion and desire to grow, and we believe that when we win big, we celebrate big. You'll collaborate, learn, and grow with some of the smartest people in the industry - and you will have a lot of fun doing it!

**Location

**Copenhagen, Denmark – hybrid (primarily office-based)

**How To Apply

**We hire on a rolling basis and will close the process once we've found the right person. If this sounds like you, don't wait, send us your application.

_Pandora is currently looking for a Student Assistant to join our Investment Governance & Performance team within Global Network Development & Insights. In this role, you will support the governance and performance tracking of investments across Pandora's global store network. You will work closely with the Franchise & Network Management team as well as local property teams, helping ensure that investment decisions are financially sound, strategically aligned, and supported by data-driven insights.

This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience with investment analysis, retail network strategy, and business performance management in one of the world's leading jewellery brands. Working closely with stakeholders across Pandora's global organization, you will gain exposure to how strategic decisions regarding store openings, relocations, lease renewals, and closures are evaluated, approved, and measured.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Contribute to optimization and automation of investment governance processes.

• Provide analysis and insights to support and improve future network investment decisions.

• Maintain and update the global investment overview and support ongoing investment governance activities.

• Upload and track Investment Proposals (IPs) and support hindsight reporting to evaluate business case performance against actual results.

• Support ongoing store classification processes and ad hoc business requests.

**Your Team

**The Global Network Development & Insights function partners with the Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) organization to provide strategic insights that shape Pandora's global retail and franchise network. The team collaborates closely with Cluster Property Directors and commercial stakeholders worldwide to drive performance, support investment decisions, and execute global growth priorities.

You will report to the Network Expansion & Investments Senior Manager and become part of a collaborative, international team focused on data-driven decision-making and strategic investment optimization.

**Qualifications

**

• Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree within Business Administration, Finance, Data Analytics, IT, or a related field.

• Ideally have around two years remaining of your studies.

• Proficient in Microsoft Excel and comfortable working with large datasets.

• Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken.

• Experience with Power BI, Power Query, Power Automate, AI, or other data and automation tools is considered an advantage.

• Interest in using data and technology to solve business challenges.

**Personal Competencies

**

• Analytical, curious, and motivated by solving complex business challenges.

• Structured, detail-oriented, and highly organized in your way of working.

• Proactive and able to take ownership of tasks while working independently.

• Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

• Collaborative and confident working with stakeholders across different functions and markets.

• Strong communication skills and a continuous improvement mindset.

• Eager to learn and develop both technical and commercial capabilities.

**What We Offer

**A position as a Student Assistant at Pandora offers you an opportunity for both personal and professional development in a global organization. This is your chance to join the world's largest jewellery brand and gain valuable experience within investment governance, business performance, and retail network strategy while working alongside talented and passionate colleagues.

**You Will Get

**

• Hands-on experience with investment analysis and decision-making in a global retail business.

• Exposure to senior stakeholders across Commercial, Finance, and Network Development.

• Insight into how data and business cases drive store investment and network decisions.

• Support and coaching from your manager and experienced team members.

• The opportunity to build analytical, commercial, and stakeholder management skills that will benefit your future career.

**Additional Information

**

• You are expected to work approximately 15-20 hours per week on average (less during exam periods and more when possible).

• The role is based at Pandora's Global Office in Copenhagen and requires physical presence.

• You must be a current student to apply.

• Start date: As soon as possible.

**Did We Get Your Attention?

**We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you would like to become part of Pandora's future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site at Pandora Group.

**Icing on the Cake

**You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world’s largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores. Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Join us in this role where you’ll originate and build new ventures from the ground up, turning bold ideas into scalable businesses. You’ll shape opportunities, validate them with the market, and drive early commercialisation, working across functions and leveraging the strength of a global organisation.

**Welcome to Ventures & Open Innovation

**You’ll be part of a team focused on identifying and scaling transformational opportunities, where you together with your colleagues will explore new markets, business models, and technologies. You’ll collaborate closely across engineering, commercial, and business development functions to bring new ideas to life. As a team, we support each other, challenge ideas constructively, and work with curiosity and ownership to turn ambition into impact.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• originating new business opportunities by identifying white spaces and shaping opportunity areas

• leading end-to-end venture building from ideation through validation to early commercialisation

• designing and testing business models through structured experimentation and rapid learning

• collaborating with internal stakeholders to unlock capabilities and move opportunities forward

• translating technical assets and capabilities into new commercial propositions

• contributing to innovation strategy and portfolio prioritisation.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have hands-on experience building new businesses or ventures from concept to launch

• bring a strong commercial mindset, focusing on customers, value creation, and revenue models

The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11% contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3% holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and wellbeing programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Certain positions may require a background check as part of the hiring process. If applicable, you will be informed during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

Do you enjoy turning business requirements and market insights into sourcing opportunities that create value for the organization? Join Ambu’s Global Indirect Procurement & Capex team and play an important role in supporting procurement across an international, fast-growing organization.

As Associate Category Manager, you will support sourcing and category management activities across indirect Procurement. Working closely with experienced Global Category Managers, you will lead or contribute to sourcing projects, supplier management activities, market analyses and stakeholder engagement while developing your sourcing & category management capabilities. You will gradually take ownership of defined sourcing activities and projects while building experience across the source-to-contract process.

You will join an ambitious global procurement organization where your work will have visible business impact. The role offers broad exposure to international stakeholders, varied indirect categories and end-to-end sourcing activities, providing a unique opportunity to build experience across a global procurement environment.

The position is based at Ambu’s headquarters in Ballerup and reports to the Director of Global Indirect Procurement & Capex.

**Key Responsibilities

**Your main responsibilities will include:

• Support the translation of business requirements and market insights into sourcing strategies and recommendations.

• Contribute to or lead RFI, RFQ and RFP processes, including supplier identification, market analysis, preparation of sourcing documentation, proposal evaluation and stakeholder coordination.

• Independently manage defined sourcing activities and less complex sourcing events using established procurement processes and tools.

• Support supplier negotiations, contract preparation and contract handover activities.

• Analyze spend, suppliers, markets and cost drivers to identify savings opportunities, value creation initiatives and risk considerations.

• Prepare sourcing analyses, recommendations and business case inputs for stakeholder decision-making.

• Build productive relationships with stakeholders, suppliers and cross-functional partners, collaborating closely with Global Category Managers and function including Legal, Quality Assurance, Finance and IT.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives, digital procurement activities and the adoption of new procurement tools and processes.

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are however likely to succeed in this position if you:

• Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree within Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Economics, Finance or a related field.

• Bring 2-3 years of experience within procurement, sourcing, category management or a related procurement function.

• Have experience supporting sourcing initiatives, supplier management activities or procurement projects.

• Understand source-to-contract processes and are comfortable working with stakeholders across different functions.

• Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn data and market insights into recommendations.

• Are a structured and proactive team player with strong communication and project coordination skills, including solid Excel and Microsoft Office capabilities.

• Communicate fluently in English and are motivated to learn and grow within a global procurement organization. Experience with sourcing platforms (e.g. Keelvar, Coupa, Ariba, GEP or similar) as well as an interest in digital procurement, AI or process automation is considered an advantage.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

Are you passionate about developing people and helping leaders succeed? PEAK Wind is seeking a Lead People & Development Specialist to strengthen leadership development, lead larger people initiatives, and provide trusted guidance on complex people matters. This is a senior generalist role for someone who combines hands-on experience with the confidence to turn business needs into practical solutions.

Introducing the People & Development Team

You will become part of our People & Development team, where we work collaboratively to attract, develop, and retain talented colleagues and support the business across the employee lifecycle. We share knowledge, support one another, and bring different perspectives to finding solutions that work for both our people and our business.

You will report to Head of People & Development and work closely with our Senior Management, leaders and colleagues across the business. As an experienced individual contributor, you will take ownership of your areas of responsibility while contributing to the wider team’s priorities.

How You Will Make an Impact

As a Lead People & Development Specialist, you will combine broad generalist responsibilities with a strong focus on leadership development and project delivery. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Support the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of leadership development initiatives, translating leaders’ needs into practical workshops, tools, and follow-up activities.

• Act as a trusted sparring partner to Senior Management and  leaders on team development, performance, collaboration, and day-to-day people decisions.

• Lead larger, cross-functional People & Development projects from scoping and planning through implementation and follow-up, managing stakeholders, dependencies, and communication.

• Handle complex and sensitive employee relations cases with sound judgement, discretion, and a structured approach, involving relevant colleagues or external advisers when needed.

• Contribute across the employee lifecycle, providing pragmatic guidance and supporting consistent people practices, policies, and processes.

• Support annual people processes, including Performance & Development Dialogues and Talent Reviews, helping leaders turn discussions into meaningful development actions.

• Identify opportunities to improve how we work and share your experience with the People & Development team to strengthen our collective delivery.

What Will Make You Successful in This Role

You are an experienced People & Development generalist who enjoys both developing people and navigating the complexity of everyday people matters. You can work independently, build trust with leaders, and balance longer-term development initiatives with hands-on delivery. You will bring:

• A relevant educational background in human resources, organisational development, psychology, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Substantial experience in a broad HR or People & Development role, with the judgement and independence to operate as a senior generalist.

• Hands-on experience supporting leadership development, including facilitating learning activities and helping leaders apply new approaches in practice.

• A track record of leading larger people projects with multiple stakeholders, from defining the need to embedding the outcome.

• Experience handling complex employee relations cases with empathy, confidentiality, and sound judgement, recognising when specialist or legal advice is needed.

• Strong relationship-building and facilitation skills, with the confidence to support and constructively challenge leaders.

• A structured, pragmatic approach and the ability to prioritise competing needs and follow through on commitments.

• Clear and effective communication skills in English, both spoken and written, and a collaborative mindset.

• Experience working with Insights profiles in individual or team development is a clear advantage; relevant accreditation is welcome but not required.

Why Join PEAK Wind

• An international, inclusive, and diverse workplace where differences are valued

• The opportunity to strengthen leadership and people practices in a business supporting the renewable energy transition

• Flexible working arrangements that support both your career and personal life

• A flat organisational structure where your ideas are welcomed and your contributions matter

• A strong focus on your learning, development, and professional growth.

• A culture that values commitment, meaningful contributions, and having fun

Our Commitment to Inclusion and Fair Hiring

We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace drives innovation, creativity, and stronger results. At PEAK Wind, we are committed to fair and transparent hiring processes, welcoming candidates from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Our hiring decisions focus on what each person brings to the role and our team, and we are committed to ensuring transparent salary structures, with pay decisions based on clear, objective, and gender‑neutral criteria. Salary information, including the relevant salary band, will be shared with candidates when they are invited to a first interview.

**About The Job

**GetWhy is the end-to-end AI-powered human insights platform trusted by the world’s most influential brands, including eBay, Arla, Warner Brothers and The Coca Cola company, to understand their customers at scale. We’re backed by $40M in Series A funding and scaling aggressively into the enterprise market.

In our category, events aren’t a nice-to-have. They are a strategic weapon. Industry conferences, hosted experiences, executive dinners and brand activations are where relationships form, pipeline is built, and GetWhy cements its position as the category leader in AI-powered qualitative research.

We’re hiring our first Lead, Global Events & Community to own how GetWhy shows up in the world. This is a high-ownership role for someone with taste, commercial instinct and relentless execution. You’ll design experiences enterprise buyers actually want to attend, turn every event into content that travels far beyond the room, and build the playbook that lets GetWhy show up brilliantly on every continent.

What you’ll do

Own the global event strategy

• Set GetWhy’s global events strategy with the marketing leadership, from tentpole industry conferences (IIEX, ESOMAR, Quirk’s) to hosted events, executive roundtables and product showcases.

• Plan, produce and execute 15–20+ events per year across Europe, the US and beyond, each tied to clear pipeline, brand and customer goals.

• Own the global events budget, sponsorship negotiations, and relationships with agencies, venues and production partners.

Make GetWhy unmissable at every conference

• Have a strong point of view on world-class conference presence, from booth concept and spatial design to merch and the small details people remember.

• Replace badge-scanning booths with live experiences: let attendees run a real GetWhy study, see AI-moderated interviews in action, and leave with an insight.

• Secure speaking slots and sponsorships that put GetWhy at the centre of the industry conversation.

Put customers on stage

• Build a flagship GetWhy-hosted event where customers present the work they’ve done with GetWhy and show other brands how to do the same.

• Recruit and prepare customer and executive speakers, and make sure every GetWhy representative on stage or on the floor is briefed and on message.

Own the side events and intimate moments

• Design VIP dinners, executive roundtables and side events around major conferences, where the real relationships are built.

• Partner with Sales and Customer Success on account-based events that move specific deals and expansions forward.

Run the content machine

• Capture on-site content at every event, including video, photos and short clips that show GetWhy’s presence on the ground.

• Turn events into social media content, such as live posts, recaps, reels and LinkedIn stories, working with the wider marketing team.

• Conduct on-site interviews with customers, speakers and industry leaders, creating content for social, the website and sales enablement.

• Make sure every event keeps working for weeks afterwards through recaps, clips and follow-up campaigns.

Turn events into revenue

• Build the pre- and post-event engine: invitations, promotion, lead capture, qualification and a seamless handoff to Sales.

• Track and report on pipeline, ROI, reach and brand impact for every event, and double down on what works.

Build the playbook

• Create scalable playbooks and “event in a box” toolkits so local teams and partners can host on-brand GetWhy events anywhere.

• Grow the events function over time, including freelancers, agencies and future hires.

• Stay ahead of new event formats and technologies, and bring the best of them to GetWhy first.

Who you are

You’re not looking for an event coordination role. You’re a builder who sees events as the highest-leverage channel in a B2B enterprise sale, and you want to prove it on a global stage.

• 3–6+ years in event marketing, field marketing or experiential marketing for B2B SaaS, enterprise tech or a high-growth scale-up.

• A portfolio of standout events, with a track record that ties them directly to pipeline and revenue.

• Real taste. You know what makes a booth, a dinner or a keynote memorable, and you can explain why.

• Commercially minded. You think about pipeline and impact, not just logistics.

• A poster, not a scroller. Social media is second nature, and you know what makes an event clip worth watching.

• Comfortable behind a camera and in front of people. You can film, run an interview and do basic editing on the fly.

• A strong operator who can run several events in parallel across time zones without dropping quality.

• An excellent communicator who can brief a designer, negotiate with a venue and pitch an executive audience.

• Comfortable with CRM and marketing automation tools such as HubSpot or Salesforce.

• A willing traveler. You go where the events are and you bring the energy.

Bonus points

• Experience from the insights, market research or MarTech industry. You know the conferences, the audience and the culture.

• Experience at an AI-native research company or a frontier AI or tech company known for its events.

• You’ve built an events function from scratch, including playbooks, processes and measurement.

• You’ve produced a flagship owned event or customer conference.

• A network of event organisers, venues and production partners across Europe and the US.

What we offer

• A fast-scaling, ambitious company where events are a core growth engine, not an afterthought.

• The chance to build GetWhy’s global events function from the ground up and define how a category leader shows up in the world.

• Real ownership, a seat close to leadership, and the budget and trust to try bold ideas.

• Work with some of the world’s most influential brands as customers, speakers and partners.

• Annual company retreats and Friday bar events. We work hard, and we celebrate hard.

How to apply

Click apply and upload your CV, LinkedIn profile, and a link to a portfolio of events you’ve produced. Event photos, clips or social posts you’ve made are a big plus.

If we see a match, we’ll invite you to a conversation online or at our office. The process includes a short creative assignment, where you’ll pitch how GetWhy should show up at one of our key industry conferences.

This isn’t the easiest events job out there. It’s the one that will define how a category leader shows up in the world. Let’s build GetWhy together.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about pharmacometrics and model-informed drug development? Do you have experience with translational and clinical population PK/PD modeling and support of regulatory submissions?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Specialist/Senior Specialist Pharmacometrician.

We are looking for a hands-on pharmacometrician who combines scientific excellence with strategic thinking and wants broad ownership across programs.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

Our Pharmacometrics Department supports every asset in the Ascendis portfolio and acts as a strategic partner throughout development, from innovation and early research through translational and clinical development, regulatory submissions, and life cycle management. Each pharmacometrician contributes directly to development strategy and portfolio decisions.

We are seeking an experienced hands-on Specialist/Senior Specialist Pharmacometrician who can address complex development questions and translate quantitative insights into actionable recommendations. You will apply model-informed drug development in rare diseases, where quantitative methods can directly inform trial design, dose selection, and evidence generation in small patient populations. You will gain exposure across translational and development stages and contribute to projects throughout the portfolio, providing broad visibility and influence within the company.

This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and collaborate with cross-functional, global teams working together to achieve extraordinary results. You will work both independently and in close collaboration with colleagues in Pharmacometrics, global project teams, external partners, and consultants. You will be joining the growing Pharmacometrics Department and report directly to Kristin Carlsson Petri, Senior Director and Head of Pharmacometrics, who is based in Hellerup. You will also be based in Hellerup. The team includes in-house pharmacometricians, a pharmacometrics programmer, and external consultants working remotely.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

• Develop model-informed drug development strategies for translational and clinical-stage projects and ensure optimal use of pharmacometric methods to inform trial and program design

• Shape regulatory strategy and represent pharmacometrics in global health authority interactions

• Inform dose selection, trial design, regulatory strategy, and lifecycle decisions through population PK/PD modeling, simulation, exposure-response analysis, and quantitative benefit-risk assessment

• Translate quantitative results into clear recommendations to project teams, senior management, health authorities, external partners or organizations

• Plan, document and report pharmacometric analyses in accordance with internal quality standards and global regulatory submission requirements

• Strengthen departmental methods, standards and capabilities through peer reviews, knowledge sharing, and continued development of the department's modeling and reporting environment

Qualifications and Skills:

You hold a PhD, MSc, or equivalent qualification in pharmacometrics, pharmaceutical sciences, pharmacokinetics, mathematics, engineering, or another relevant quantitative discipline. You have relevant experience with PK/PD modeling and model-informed drug development.

Furthermore, you have:

• Hands-on experience with NONMEM and R applied to population PK/PD model development, simulation, and model-informed drug development

• Strong programming skills and technical expertise to organize, perform, document, and report pharmacometric analyses to submission standard

• Experience with translational and clinical-stage analyses, including population PK, PK/PD, exposure-response, dose selection, and trial-design questions

Additional experience that would be an advantage:

• Industrial experience supporting regulatory interactions or submissions, including knowledge of relevant FDA, EMA, and ICH expectations for pharmacometric analyses

• Familiarity with LaTeX, Git and reproducible reporting workflows, or experience applying machine learning, artificial intelligence, or automation to pharmacometric workflows

Key competencies:

• You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude

• You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key

• You communicate complex quantitative findings clearly, work effectively across disciplines, and balance analytical detail with broader development objectives

• You combine a strong quantitative background with biological and clinical understanding and collaborate effectively with scientists, clinicians, regulatory colleagues, and external partners. Your ability to share knowledge and contribute to common goals will be valued among colleagues

Travel: 5-10 days per year.

Office: Tuborg Boulevard 12, Hellerup, Denmark.

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform-applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For further information about the position, please contact Kristin Carlsson Petri, Senior Director and Head of Pharmacometrics at kcp@ascendispharma.com.

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website www.ascendispharma.com.

Applications must be submitted in English and will be treated confidentially.

A note to recruiters:

We do not allow external search party solicitation. Presentation of candidates without written permission from the Ascendis Pharma HR team—specifically a Talent Acquisition Partner or Human Resources Director—is not allowed. If this occurs, your ownership of these candidates will not be acknowledged.

When it comes to photos, we prefer to form our first impression face to face rather than from a picture. If relevant, please also attach your portfolio.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI – inclusion is key
